name: Thunderforest Map
description: A map of a place from Thunderforest (OpenStreetMap data), in one of their styles: transport shows the bus and rail lines, cycle the cycle routes. The places are kept in the data source's settings, and a task picks one, or the device's own location. The API key is in the Thunderforest settings (the free plan is enough: a map is kept for a week).

properties.name: places
properties.title: Places
properties.description: The places a task can show a map of, each with a name and a location chosen on a map (search for an address, or click the map). A task picks one by its name, or shows the device's own location when it picks none.

properties.name: place
properties.title: Place
properties.description: Which place to show a map of. Leave it empty for the device's own location (System settings). Add places (a name and a location each) in the Thunderforest Map settings.

properties.name: style
properties.title: Map Style
properties.description: transport: bus and rail lines. cycle: cycle routes and hills. outdoors: paths and terrain. landscape: land cover and terrain. atlas: a plain road map.

properties.name: zoom
properties.title: Zoom
properties.description: How close the map is: 1 shows the world, 10 a city, 14 a neighbourhood, 17 a few streets.
